**What changes, and why**

**How it was checked**
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (in a second time zone too, e.g. `TZ=UTC`)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Recorded nights replayed, if the change can move a verdict (say which, and what moved)
- [ ] Both languages updated for every new sentence a person reads, and both READMEs if behaviour changed

**What was not checked**

- [ ] No camera addresses, passwords, keys, site coordinates or real-site recordings in the change
